subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the A2UI dashboard bridge wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the canonical web action-ingress contract, or should dashboard widgets define their own bridge contract first?
rationale: The request spans product direction and a security boundary because it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted dashboard and Gateway paths.

options.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or design the browser Canvas action sink first, then adapt dashboard widgets to that canonical contract.

options.title: Sponsor dashboard-first bridge
options.body: Allow the dashboard stack to define the action bridge now, accepting that Canvas ingress must later conform to that dashboard-origin contract.

options.title: Move out of bundled core
options.body: If the dashboard bridge is not a bundled product direction, leave it for an external plugin or ClawHub package after the required APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or design the browser Canvas action sink first, then adapt dashboard widgets to that canonical contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main precedent for bundled Control UI plugin tabs and is the best available product-routing signal for whether this becomes a bundled dashboard capability.
